reviews.review:
In general I would say this game has a good base but the story is not very well structured and seems to be rushed a bit. I didn't notice anything really at the stops where you make the choice to leave / get back on the bus since they were all the same with no one to talk to or interact with. Overall the game is very bare at the moment and in one of the screenshots on the store page I notice a packed bus? Maybe the dev was going to do more with the game but from my gameplay and what I saw from others no one really gets on or off the bus. The game like I mentioned before really doesn't have much going for it at the moment 

https://youtu.be/IeRtiC-z2k8
